Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to delete this Digimon itself?

Card Q&A.a: 1 of your level 4 or lower purple Digimon or 1 of your level 4 or lower red Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What Digimon's deletion will trigger this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3, 1 of their level 4 and 1 of their level 5 Digimon.
[On Deletion] By deleting 1 of your level 4 or lower purple or red Digimon, you may play 1 [Machinedramon] from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -1: 3 Lv.4 [Composite] trait Digimon cards w/different card numbers
